children: DeepBook has launched its standalone app in Alpha, offering spot trading on Sui's deepest order book, 1-minute BTC prediction markets, and a full API from day one. The waitlist is closed, so new users access the app through its regular onboarding rather than an invite queue.

The release gives DEEP a direct retail-facing channel, since trading activity now runs through DeepBook's own frontend instead of relying on third-party interfaces built on the order book. Prediction markets and an open API broaden the product surface beyond spot trading and give programmatic users day-one access. Adoption is still unproven in Alpha, so trading volume and fee flow are the metrics to watch as usage shifts to this app.
DeepBook App is LIVE in Alpha.
Spot on the deepest book on Sui.

title: DeepBook: Alpha App Goes Live With Spot Trading, BTC Prediction Markets, and API - 24 Sep 2026
